complete_examples.text: The track irregularity probability model is introduced, and incorporating the point selection strategy with Generalized F-discrepancy into TIPM is applied to simulate the track irregularities in Section 2.

Besides, an adaptive surrogate model approach for random vibration analysis of the train–bridge system is proposed, and a point selection method based on Generalized F-discrepancy is introduced to improve the prediction accuracy of the surrogate model (Zhang et al., 2023).
